import os,glob,re
exec(open(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR']+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n').split('def load')[0]) if False else None
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
ti,di,do_=G['Test input'],G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']
# cells in demo: find cells (between 6-lines)
def cells(g,line):
    # gridlines: rows/cols fully line
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    hr=[i for i in range(h) if all(v==line for v in g[i])]
    hc=[j for j in range(w) if all(g[i][j]==line for i in range(h))]
    print(hr,hc)
cells(di,6)
# print shapes per cell
def show(g,line):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    hr=[i for i in range(h) if all(v==line for v in g[i])]
    hc=[j for j in range(w) if all(g[i][j]==line for i in range(h))]
    rb=[-1]+hr; cb=[-1]+hc
    for a in range(len(rb)-1):
        for b in range(len(cb)-1):
            sub=[r[cb[b]+1:cb[b+1]] for r in g[rb[a]+1:rb[a+1]]]
            if any(any(v==line for v in r) for r in sub):
                print('cell',a,b)
                for r in sub: print(' '.join(str(v%10) if v!=line else '.' for v in r))
show(di,6)
print('OUT')
show(do_,6)

def find_sep(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    rows=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(grid[r]))==1]
    cols=[c for c in range(W) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1]
    seps=Counter(grid[r][0] for r in rows)
    return rows,cols,seps
for name,g in [('DI',DI),('D2I',D2I),('TI',TI)]:
    rws,cls,sf=find_sep(g)
    print(name, g.shape if hasattr(g,'shape') else (len(g),len(g[0])), 'full rows:',rws,'full cols:',cls, dict(sf))

def transform(grid):
    g=[list(r) for r in grid]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    rws=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(g[r]))==1]
    cls=[cc for cc in range(W) if len({g[r][cc] for r in range(H)})==1]
    sep=g[rws[0]][0]
    rb=blocks_1d(H,rws); cb=blocks_1d(W,cls)
    colors={g[r][cc] for r in range(H) for cc in range(W)}-{0,sep}
    for c in colors:
        cells={}
        for ri,(r0,r1) in enumerate(rb):
            for ci,(c0,c1) in enumerate(cb):
                cont=cell_content(g,r0,r1,c0,c1,c)
                if any(any(row) for row in cont): cells[(ri,ci)]=cont
        if not cells: continue
        ris={ri for ri,ci in cells}; cis={ci for ri,ci in cells}
        if len(ris)!=2 or len(cis)!=2: continue
        r0i,r1i=sorted(ris); c0i,c1i=sorted(cis)
        posmap={(r0i,c0i):'TL',(r0i,c1i):'TR',(r1i,c0i):'BL',(r1i,c1i):'BR'}
        empt=[p for p in posmap if p not in cells]
        if len(empt)!=1: continue
        q=empt[0]; qpos=posmap[q]
        if 'TL' not in [posmap[p] for p in cells]: continue
        tl=[p for p in cells if posmap[p]=='TL'][0]
        C=cells[tl]; ch=len(C); cw=len(C[0])
        if not all(cells[p]==VAR[posmap[p]](C) for p in cells if p!=tl): continue
        X=[row[:] for row in C]
        rows_any=[i for i in range(ch) if any(X[i])]
        cols_any=[j for j in range(cw) if any(X[i][j] for i in range(ch))]
        lo,hi=min(rows_any),max(rows_any); lco,hco=min(cols_any),max(cols_any)
        # duplicate a single missing edge line when the other dimension spans the full cell
        if lco==0 and hco==cw-1 and lo==1 and hi==ch-1: X[0]=X[1][:]
        elif lo==0 and hi==ch-1 and lco==1 and hco==cw-2: 
            for i in range(ch): X[i][0]=X[i][1]
        F=VAR[qpos](X)
        (r0,r1)=rb[q[0]]; (c0,c1)=cb[q[1]]
        for i in range(len(F)):
            for j in range(len(F[0])):
                if F[i][j]: g[r0+i][c0+j]=c
    return g
